edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the initial owner via _transferOwnership and receives the minted total supply
_transfer reaches the contract through transfer/transferFrom which use _msgSender()
enableTrading records block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime so the LP burn schedule is miner manipulable
_transfer compares block.timestamp with lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency to trigger LP burns
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline so execution timing is miner controlled
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes block.timestamp to lastLpBurnTime
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens gates execution on block.timestamp versus lastManualLpBurnTime
_transfer keys the per-block anti-bot map on tx.origin which can be spoofed through intermediary contracts
_holderLastTransferTimestamp indexed by tx.origin enforces only one purchase per block
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract token balance exceeds swapTokensAtAmount and swapping is allowed
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when the time and pair conditions hold
fee computation amount.mul(totalFees).div(100), bucket splits and the amount -= fees reduction execute in _transfer
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens into ETH
swapBack calls addLiquidity to pair the remaining ETH with half the liquidity tokens
swapBack performs an unchecked low-level ETH call to devWallet before finishing accounting
swapBack forwards the entire remaining contract ETH balance to marketingWallet by low-level call
swapBack triggers an external router swap that invokes token callbacks during state updates
addLiquidityEth router call is an external interaction with ETH value inside swapBack
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the pair which can execute attacker controlled code
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the pair which can execute attacker controlled code
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router fee-on-transfer swap with slippage set to zero
addLiquidity invokes the external router addLiquidityETH with zero minimum amounts
